classification.difficultyReason: Scale the two familiar reading durations by the page-count ratio, compare and convert minutes to seconds; a short modelling chain.

content.prompt: Sarah takes 4 hours and 55 minutes to complete a 200-page novel, while Derek takes 5 hours and 12 minutes. Reading at the same speeds, how much faster is Sarah than Derek, in seconds, if they both read a 300-page novel?

answer.worked: For 200 pages, Derek takes $5(60)+12=312$ minutes and Sarah takes $4(60)+55=295$ minutes, a difference of 17 minutes. At unchanged speeds, the time difference for 300 pages is $17\times\frac{300}{200}=25.5$ minutes. Thus $25.5\times60=1530$ seconds.
